title: Retro Screens
summary: Three classic-genre screens under console-era limits: an 8-bit rooftop platformer, a Game Boy-style village RPG and an 8-bit title screen whose city is the san-francisco rebuild (from a user-attested Pexels reference not included here).
request: Unknown: the original request was not recorded in the repository. SOURCES notes describe the characters, places, titles and text as original; console names describe hardware limits only. The Pixel Harbor city behind the title screen is the san-francisco rebuild, made from a user-supplied Pexels photo not included in the repository. Source description: original classic-genre screens under console-era limits: an 8-bit platformer, a Game Boy-style RPG, an 8-bit title screen.

anatomy.draws: Rooftop Run: NES-style side-scrolling platformer over San Francisco rooftops, parallax layers, 160 frames
anatomy.change_for: the platformer screen, its hero and skyline

anatomy.draws: Island Village: Game Boy-style top-down RPG village with windmill, cat, gull and dialogue box (4 shades, 160x144)
